name: glitter
description: Glitter, a desktop coding-agent app with its own agent harness

scripts.dev: npm run build:bridge && npm run tauri -w @glitter/desktop -- dev
scripts.build: npm run notices && npm run build:bridge && npm run tauri -w @glitter/desktop -- build
scripts.preview: npm run build:ui && npm run preview -w @glitter/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @glitter/harness && npm run typecheck -w @glitter/desktop
scripts.verify: npm run check:versions && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:ui && npm run check:a11y && npm run check:contrast && npm audit --audit-level=high && npm run check:notices && npm run build:bridge && npm run build:ui && node scripts/check-chunks.mjs && npm run build:website && npm run test:native
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['apps/desktop/dist','apps/website/dist','packages/glitter-harness/dist']) require('fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
